cases.name: Jenna Jacobsen
cases.about: Chris Jacobsen also said that his daughter was “an extremely kind, loving young woman.” He added that his daughter had plans to go to college and to become a vet. Jacobsen’s sister, Jillian, told WPBF, “Jenna was a great person. She was really kind. She has been through a lot. She is really brave and one of the strongest people I know. Jacobsen was a 2017 graduate of East Islip High School. One of the final updates on Jacobsen’s Facebook page says that she worked in catering for Timber Point Country Club Restaurant & Catering.
